newsitem.title: UK: ENIC to take control of Vicenza soccer club.
newsitem.headline: ENIC to take control of Vicenza soccer club.

text.p: English National Investment Company Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed a deal that would ultimately give it a controlling stake in Italian soccer club Vicenza.
Investment trust ENIC, which has links with Scottish champions Glasgow Rangers, reached agreement with Britain's Stellican Limited to acquire 29.9 percent of Vicenza for 2.4 million stg.
It has an option to raise its stake to 62 percent, taking its total net investment in the northern Italian club to five million stg.
ENIC, in which Bahamas-based millionaire financier Joe Lewis is an investor, has an option to buy Lewis' 25-percent stake in Rangers for 40 million stg.
Vicenza last month became Italy's first foreign owned soccer club when Stellican bought it for 22.75 billion lire in a bankruptcy court.
Under the new deal, Vicenza will be jointly owned by ENIC, Estimator Limited, which is a Stellican affiliate, CSI Limited and Pangolin International Limited.
Estimator is owned by Stellican managing director Stephen Julius while CSI distributes the overseas television rights for the English Premier League.

Pangolin is a private investment company representing the interests of Robert Hersov. Hersov is managing director of Italian pay-television operator Telepiu and a director of Silvio Berlusconi's Mediaset.
